page_title: WOL 0-1 BOU | Wolves v Bournemouth 24/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The match has just finished.
90+12' Celebrations are cut short for Wolves as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
90+12' The Wolves players joy may have been justified, because referee Stuart Attwell is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
90+9' A goal, which was scored by Max Kilman (Wolves), was disallowed due to offside.
90+9' The resulting corner, taken by Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves), comes to nothing.

90+9' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+9' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) tackles a bit over-zealously and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.

90+8' Nathan Fraser (Wolves) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Mark Travers. This effort really didn't trouble him.
90+6' The attendance is 25541.
90+5' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
90+5' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+3' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nathan Fraser (Wolves) comes onto the pitch so that Toti can be given a rest.
90+2' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+2' Bournemouth try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
90+2' Poor challenge! Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) is penalised for tripping and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle. Bournemouth get a free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
90' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

90' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Wolves are going to take it.

89' Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
89' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
89' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Stuart Attwell stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Wolves will take a free kick.
87' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Dominic Solanke is replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
87' It is time for a substitution. James Hill (Bournemouth) is on for Marcos Senesi.
87' Wasted effort! Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
87' A cross from Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
86' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) works the corner short.
86' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nelson Semedo (Wolves). The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.
84' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) sends a long ball in, but Jose Sa comfortably gathers the ball.
84' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner but it's cleared.
83' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. The ball is out of play and Bournemouth manage to earn a corner.

83' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
81' The substitution is prepared. Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alex Scott.
80' The VAR review is over and the red card for Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) stands! Off he trudges.

80' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth), but referee Stuart Attwell must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
79' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
78' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
78' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
77' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mark Travers comes off the line to clear the ball away.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is brought on as a substitute for Justin Kluivert.
74' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
74' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
73' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
72' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
69' The game is interrupted as Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is flagged offside.
69' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Matheus Cunha (Wolves) for a tough tackle.
69' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Wolves players look gutted.
68' Wait! Referee Stuart Attwell has indicated he is going to review the Wolves goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.

65' The ball hits the back of the net! Nelson Semedo showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it low into the middle of the net – 1:1.
64' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves) replaces Pablo Sarabia.
64' The substitution has been made. Boubacar Traore (Wolves) has replaced Joao Gomes.

64' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
64' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
64' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
63' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
61' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Matt Doherty (Wolves) for his blatant foul.

59' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
59' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

59' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
57' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
57' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) takes the corner.
56' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matheus Cunha (Wolves) comes onto the pitch for Thomas Doyle.

55' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
55' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

55' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner.
53' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bournemouth are taking a throw-in.
52' Matt Doherty (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Travers comes off his line to gather the ball.
51' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

50' Matt Doherty (Wolves) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
48' Stuart Attwell blows the whistle, Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is penalised for a foul.
46' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Santiago Bueno will be replaced by Matt Doherty (Wolves).
46' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends a long ball in, but Mark Travers comfortably gathers the ball.
45+1' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. Bournemouth have been awarded a free kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
44' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
44' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Wolves earn a corner.
43' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) makes a slide tackle, but referee Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
42' Mark Travers comes off his line to intercept the corner from Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
41' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
40' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
39' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
39' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stuart Attwell signals. Wolves are awarded a free kick.
37' 0 - 1 Goal! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
37' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

36' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
36' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and it's Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
33' Max Kilman (Wolves) makes a strong challenge and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
33' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends a long ball in, but Mark Travers comfortably gathers the ball.
33' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

33' Mario Lemina (Wolves) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee blows his whistle, Wolves are awarded a corner kick.

31' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Stuart Attwell with no other option than to blow for a foul.
31' A lofted cross from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
30' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
30' Bournemouth continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
29' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Thomas Doyle (Wolves). A free kick is awarded to Bournemouth.
29' The free kick from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
28' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul after Nelson Semedo (Wolves) hacks down one of his opponents. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bournemouth.
28' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

27' What a wasted opportunity by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Jose Sa makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
26' A quickly taken corner by Bournemouth.
25' The ball is cleared after Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Bournemouth can continue in their attacking effort.
25' Bournemouth take a short corner kick.
24' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
23' A yellow card for a tackle by Nelson Semedo (Wolves). Stuart Attwell doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
20' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
20' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and signals a foul after Joao Gomes (Wolves) brought his opponent down.

19' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
19' Bournemouth get a corner.

18' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Jose Sa anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
16' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) jumps into a tackle and Stuart Attwell signals a foul.
16' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
15' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nelson Semedo (Wolves).

14' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Mark Travers didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
13' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
13' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes a short corner kick.

12' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Mark Travers has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Wolves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bournemouth.
9' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bournemouth.
7' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle as Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
7' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his powerful header from near the penalty spot crashes against the crossbar!
7' Now Bournemouth have a corner.

6' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Jose Sa easily deals with the threat. It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
5' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

4' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bournemouth.
1' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) heads on.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolves will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Stuart Attwell.
